truth_record.title: Shared counter locking is compiled out on non-64-bit builds while the resource remains shared

code_windows.content:
#define LOG_DEBUG(fmt, ...)   _log_wrapper(LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG, __FILE__, __LINE__, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define LOG_INFO(fmt, ...)    _log_wrapper(LOG_LEVEL_INFO, __FILE__, __LINE__, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define LOG_WARN(fmt, ...)    _log_wrapper(LOG_LEVEL_WARN, __FILE__, __LINE__, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)

#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64) || defined(__aarch64__)
#define COUNTER_SLOT_LOCK() LOCK(&g_lifecycle_counter_lock)
#define COUNTER_SLOT_UNLOCK() UNLOCK(&g_lifecycle_counter_lock)
#else
#define COUNTER_SLOT_LOCK() do { } while (0)
#define COUNTER_SLOT_UNLOCK() do { } while (0)
#endif
